pkgmetadata.longdescription:
NEC's configuration payload for the SX-Aurora TSUBASA MMM stack: ve_hw_spec.yaml (per-sensor sysfs map ve_monitor loads at daemon start -- missing it logs "MMM Yaml file change error"), per-board ve_nodes JSON files, analysis tables and the mmm-config-json.sh helper that picks the right ve_nodes.json for the host at install time.
Split out of the vendor's mmm RPM family exactly as upstream ships it (mmm-config is a separate RPM from mmm).
